body:
Likely to try and resolve later, but this appears to have to do with how the PackedScene is serialized when the node is added for the first time.

I followed the steps in the MRP, and reproduced the error exactly, using the No Default, True Value scene.

When the node is initially added to Test Scene, Test Scene.tscn stores it as
```
[node name="MyClass - No Default - Value True" type="Label" parent="Parent" instance=ExtResource("1_ia1lp")]
layout_mode = 2
script = ExtResource("2_sasra")
toggle_me = true
```

The first time "Toggle Me" is toggled from True to False, this updates the .tscn storage to:
```
[node name="MyClass - No Default - Value True" type="Label" parent="Parent" instance=ExtResource("1_ia1lp")]
layout_mode = 2
script = ExtResource("2_sasra")
```

So obviously whatever process de-serializes TestScene.tscn will just instantiate a fresh instance of No Default, True Value with the value still being true. Whether this be running an instance of the project, or reloading the scene. Continuing to toggle "Toggle Me" without reloading the scene just toggles between the two above states.

If TestScene is closed, and reloaded from either State, Toggle Me will still be true - either the saved file specified it should be true (state 1) or didn't specify (state 2), so we go with the value from the Prefab scene, still True. However saving TestScene again from here produces a new state:

```
[node name="MyClass - No Default - Value True" parent="Parent" instance=ExtResource("1_ia1lp")]
layout_mode = 2
```

Toggling the variable now produces a correct serialization of the state.
```
[node name="MyClass - No Default - Value True" parent="Parent" instance=ExtResource("1_ia1lp")]
layout_mode = 2
toggle_me = false
```
From here on out, the serialization will always be correct.
